acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Celestials family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Seraph, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Orrery-of-Orders Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A symmetrical being with a body mostly made of bounded family-native light, only a clear humanoid suggestion within, innumerable feathered wings grouped into four readable tiers, and a complex halo operating as a visible four-axle orrery.

Signature mechanic: Living Orrery: four halo orbits turn around the Seraph's mostly luminous body. The Word orbit calls Messengers to draw radial ribbons; the Guard orbit places Guardians on a diameter; the Warden orbit counter-rotates paired script axes; and the Archon orbit combines two surviving orders under a six-wing marshal. Wings beyond counting are layered into four readable tiers, each bracing one orbit through a visible gold axle. The Seraph covers the active orbit with three wing tiers but must open the matching tier to issue its command. Striking that axle during the learned lower-form safe window destroys the orbit, dismisses its command, and causes one entire wing tier to fold into the body's clearer humanoid outline. After two breaks, the remaining orbits slow and run sequentially rather than together.
battlefieldDuty: Command a four-orbit boss arena through layered wings and a working orrery halo, issuing and combining lower-form geometries until destroyed axles permanently reduce both orders and bodily abstraction.
constructionDimensions: Feathers and halos become pressure machinery through vane-layered pinions, hollow ring flutes, sail-cut ribbons, vented armor, and wing-pair channels that scale explicitly from two wings at T1–T2 to four, six, and many-tiered wings at T3–T5.
Motion exposes force direction through counted wing camber, script and ribbon streamlines, pressure distortion confined to selected axes, and a still center at the halo bearing, mask, or orrery axle.
counterplay: Read the chosen orbit and lower-form formation, enter its learned safe line or quadrant, then strike the exposed gold axle before the wing tier closes; each destroyed orbit permanently removes a command and makes later phases slower, more sequential, and more humanoid. Affinity signal: One wing pair and its ribbons align while the governing halo bearing becomes perfectly still; crossing the lee or striking that still center breaks the pressure decree.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only wind treatment without vane feathers, flute geometry, and directional pressure
Glow-only wind treatment without a still center or readable force route
Ordinary wing beats presented as Wind affinity without altered feather and halo construction
Cloud or debris effects that obscure wing count, script order, halo joints, or body symmetry
identityInvariants: An idealized upright humanoid silhouette remains deliberately symmetrical, with feathered wings and a halo above or behind the head even as the body becomes increasingly abstract.
White, ivory, pale gold, sunlight yellow, and sky blue remain family-native ordered radiance rather than elemental affinity colors.
Polished gold, white marble, feather, silk, and source-native pure light stay layered so armor, cloth, wing roots, halo joints, and the suggested body remain readable.
Halos, ring geometry, sacred script, ribbons, censers, blank ceremonial masks, and wing count communicate rank through exact symmetry and moving parts rather than glow or size alone.
Escalation increases wing pairs and halo complexity from a simple ring to an orrery, but each tier preserves a breakable alignment joint and a learnable ordered command.
telegraph: One orrery orbit stops against a gold axle, its matching tier among the many wings opens like measured shutters, sacred script names the selected geometry, and the lower Celestials assume their familiar symmetric positions.
